title.zh: 电子与空穴：一次激发产生一对载流子
title.en: Electrons and holes: excitation creates a carrier pair

subtitle.zh: 热激发 / 光激发 / 电子—空穴对 / 产生与复合
subtitle.en: Thermal/optical excitation / electron–hole pairs / generation and recombination

body.zh: 电子跨越带隙进入导带，价带缺位等效为空穴参与输运。吸收光子hν或热能 → 获得足够能量跨E_g到E_c、在E_v留下空穴 → 电子和空穴在电场下各自导电 → 复合释放光子或声子。晶格示意中蓝色为原子（如Si）、橙色电子、虚线空心圆为空穴。
body.en: When an electron crosses the gap into conduction, its valence vacancy acts as a transporting hole. Absorb photon hν or heat → cross E_g to E_c, leaving a hole at E_v → electron/hole transport under a field → recombine, releasing photons or phonons. In the lattice, blue denotes atoms such as Si, orange electrons and dashed hollow circles holes.

body.zh: 温度越高热激发越强；hν≥E_g时可产生电子—空穴对；带隙越小越易激发、本征浓度越高。缺陷杂质提供非辐射复合通道，影响寿命。更高T或更强光增加载流子，但缺陷增加或高注入可能缩短有效寿命、增强非辐射复合并降低效率。
body.en: Higher temperature increases thermal excitation; hν≥E_g can create pairs; smaller gaps ease excitation and raise intrinsic concentration. Defects/impurities provide nonradiative paths and affect lifetime. Higher T or stronger light raises carriers, but defects/high injection may shorten effective lifetime, increase nonradiative recombination and reduce efficiency.

body.zh: 暗电流过大：无光电流偏高。寿命短：复合中心过多。光响应弱：吸收/收集效率低。高注入效率下降：非辐射复合增强。PL复合发光强度反映辐射效率；TRPL等寿命测试量电子/空穴寿命；暗/光I–V评估本征或缺陷暗电流；lnσ–1/T分析热激发和带隙。
body.en: High dark current means elevated unilluminated current; short lifetime suggests many recombination centers; weak photoresponse suggests poor absorption/collection; high-injection efficiency loss suggests stronger nonradiative recombination. PL probes radiative efficiency, TRPL probes lifetime, dark/light I–V evaluates intrinsic/defect dark current and lnσ–1/T probes activation/gap.

body.zh: 光探测器把光生载流子变电信号；太阳能电池分离并收集光生载流子；LED依电子空穴辐射复合发光；产生/复合影响漏电和开关速度。直接带隙如GaAs、InP辐射复合效率较高；间接带隙如Si需要声子参与动量守恒，辐射效率较低，发光及光电表现不同。
body.en: Photodetectors convert photocarriers to electrical signals; solar cells separate/collect them; LEDs emit through radiative recombination; generation/recombination affects leakage and switching. Direct-gap GaAs/InP have higher radiative efficiency; indirect-gap Si needs phonons for momentum conservation and has lower radiative efficiency, affecting optoelectronic use.

notes.zh: 原图同时写电子和空穴“向电场方向输运”，却画相反方向箭头；这是源图的方向表述冲突。正文仅保留二者受场输运的共同结论，不把该标注当作准确方向定律。
notes.en: The source labels both electrons and holes as moving “along the electric field” while drawing opposite arrows. This is a source-direction inconsistency. The text retains field-driven transport without treating those labels as a correct directional law.

uncertain: 原图右下方水印与页底图文区域重叠；保留完整图表时不能仅靠矩形裁剪无损去除，未猜补被覆盖像素。 / The lower-right watermark overlaps the lower-page content region; a rectangular crop cannot remove it while preserving every diagram. Covered pixels have not been reconstructed.
原图本身的概念或标注疑点已在notes中逐项说明，不能把原图视作已校正技术图。 / Source conceptual or labeling concerns are itemized in notes; the source is not a corrected technical diagram.
